test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A loss of 25% gets converted into a profit of 12% when the selling price of an article is increased by Rs. 111. Find the cost price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

A loss of 25% gets converted into a profit of 12% when the selling price of an article is increased by Rs. 111.

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) / (1 + Profit%)

Loss = Cost Price (CP) - Selling Price (SP)

Profit = Selling Price (SP) - Cost Price
